Macaque M interactive explorer cloned from the final Mouse-M user interface.
Panels: frozen 18-feature comparison/t-SNE editor and four-panel T-M RRR editor.
Cells: 117 HC-GC consensus MSN cells; M1=43, M2=42, M3=20, M4=12.
Feature values and transformed Z scores come from the frozen Macaque M analysis.
t-SNE Z range is fixed by default at -2.5 to 2.5; saved __z columns are used directly.
M colors: M1 #1F77B4; M2 #D9A400; M3 #8C564B; M4 #E377C2.
RRR radial display scaling remains the 99th-percentile rule used by the source panel.
